page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top: page number "64" at left, title "De Episcopatu" centred, "Q. VI." at right. One column of running text, continuing from the previous page. Centred heading "QUÆST. VII." with its question in italic below it. No marginal notes. Catchword "Bellarmi-" at right below the last line.

main_text.p: [?]nis faciunt, ut Bullingerus loquitur à me citatus. Idem etiam patet ex Thesi X & hinc inde ex totâ Disputatione. Unde facile respondere est ad exemplum Magistratus Hierosolymitani. Is enim præcipiebat Apostolis illicita & impia, cujus jussu consequenter illi non tenebantur obedire, sed mandato Dei, qui contrarium ipsis præceperat Act.[?]4.5.capp. Cui accedit quòd ego loquor per totam Disputationem, ut expressè protestatus sum in Proœmio, non de quovis Magistratu summo, sed de Orthodoxo, qualis certè Magistratus ille non erat; quemadmodum stultè quidam Pontificii sentiunt, qui existimant Ecclesiam illam, quæ Christum & Apostolos condemnavit, ac persecuta est, veram Ecclesiam fuisse. Atque hoc est illud ipsum discrimen, quòd inter potestatem Magistratus circa res Religionis & circa merè civiles in Consideratione rectè statuitur.
main_text.head: QUÆST. VII. An Magistratus curam gerere debeat, ne ministri Ecclesiæ disciplina Ecclesiastica abutantur, & alicui injuriam faciant?

page.notes: The first word "nis" is a fragment of a line from the previous page, printed in italic and not fully certain. The heading question is in italic and its last words are sharp in the scan. The citation "Act.4.5.capp." has a ligature in "Act" that is hard to read, so I have marked it. The catchword "Bellarmi-" is at the foot of the page. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
